title: trusted_peers parse error silently disables peering auth (fail-open)
description: transit/src/main.rs: parse_trusted_peer_keys errors are caught with unwrap_or_else returning empty Vec with only a warning log. A typo in any trusted_peers key silently disables all peer authentication. Fail-open security control. Maintenance consequence: misconfigured key is indistinguishable from intentionally open config.
